q: In 1 John, what does John say God is?
why: Whoever does not love does not know God.
quote: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.

q: In 1 John, why should we love one another?
quote: Beloved, let us love one another, because love comes from God.

q: In 1 John, how was God's love revealed among us?
why: So that we might live through Him.
quote: God sent His one and only Son into the world, so that we might live through Him.

q: In 1 John, love is not that we loved God, but that what?
quote: not that we loved God, but that He loved us

q: In 1 John, since God so loved us, what ought we to do?
quote: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.

q: In 1 John, what does perfect love drive out?
why: There is no fear in love.
quote: There is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear

q: In 1 John, why do we love?
quote: We love because He first loved us.

q: In 1 John, whoever loves God must also love whom?
quote: Whoever loves God must love his brother as well.

q: In 1 John, what will God do if we confess our sins?
quote: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins

q: In 1 John, what has the Father's love made us?
why: And that is what we are!
quote: that we should be called children of God. And that is what we are!

q: In 1 John, God is light, and in Him there is no what?
why: This is the message from Him.
quote: God is light, and in Him there is no darkness at all.

q: In 1 John, if anyone sins, who is our advocate before the Father?
quote: we have an advocate before the Father—Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.

q: In 1 John, we should love not only in word, but in what?
quote: Little children, let us love not in word and speech, but in action and truth.

q: In 1 John, what are believers told not to love?
why: The Father's love must come first.
quote: Do not love the world or anything in the world.

q: In 1 John, why did John write to believers?
a: So they know they have eternal life
quote: so that you may know that you have eternal life.

q: In 1 John, what is someone who says he loves God but hates his brother?
why: Love for God shows in love for others.
quote: If anyone says, “I love God,” but hates his brother, he is a liar.

q: How does the letter of 1 John end?
why: A final warning to his little children.
quote: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.

q: In 1 John, no one has ever seen God, but if we love one another, what happens?
why: His love is perfected in us.
quote: but if we love one another, God remains in us, and His love is perfected in us.

q: In 1 John, perfected love gives us confidence on which day?
why: We are like Him in this world.
quote: so that we may have confidence on the day of judgment
